mine_user_agreement_content:
Xiaomi Earbuds User Agreement:

1. Acceptance of Terms: By using Xiaomi Earbuds, you agree to be bound by this user agreement.
2. Use of Service: You may manage and customize features of your compatible Xiaomi wireless earphones.
3. Updates: The application may automatically check and apply firmware updates to maintain device security and stability.
4. Intellectual Property: All trademarks, logos, and software remain the exclusive property of Xiaomi Inc.
mine_user_privacy_policy_content:
Xiaomi Earbuds Privacy Policy:

1. Data Collection: We only collect information necessary for the operation of your devices (battery levels, audio settings, ANC profiles).
2. Security: All Bluetooth communications are encrypted using secure Xiaomi RCSP protocols.
3. Local Processing: Your equalizer settings and gesture command assignments are stored locally on your computer.
4. Revocation: You may revoke your consent at any time in the profile settings.
